★Request
Satono (left of screen), Mac enters from right of screen

If we do not pass, we will not be acknowledged, you know?
And yet—!

A match race against Mejiro McQueen. —Conditions: 2400m on turf.
The battle with my fate as her Trainer on the line had begun.

(In the early phase... she seems to be keeping up somehow.
However, 2400m is long. What lies ahead is the real test.)

That is why we devoted ourselves purely to "what is needed right now."
Even if it may displease you...
Ghhhuuuaaaahhh!

And so, having somehow made it through the Satono family's trial,
I was officially accepted as her Trainer. However—

"Speed" viable in a 2000m GⅠ. While we cannot demonstrate the
all-around strength to win at 2400m right now, this speed will pave the way to future GⅠs.
Would you care to explain, you two?

(There is... no regret in her eyes...
Does this look mean... she gave it everything she had?)

Yes... that was during the Classic season.
Back when everyone burned with faint dreams, competing with one another...

...I understand, McQueen-san.
We will...

Mejiro McQueen was looking this way
with a gentle, maternal smile.

If so, something needs to change. And if a girl who has
shattered jinxes time and again felt something, then...

You were not aiming for "victory," were you?
Nor did you condition her specifically for 2400m.

(Is she... not looking at me?
Even when I call out, not at all. And what's more—)

Neither winning nor specializing...?
Whatever do you mean by that...?

...Before I give my verdict, I must ask why you ran
the way you did today. Miss Satono, were you—

Let's make our dream come true! We will definitely break
the greatest jinx that no one before could! The two of us together!

And the look in Miss Satono's eyes when she lost...
It was so much like how I used to be.

Trainer. Please take good care of Dia from here on out.
Entrusted to you is our family's finest uncut gem—
Thinking about the upcoming Junior Class, GⅠ races cap at 2000m. As her Trainer, I cannot make a call that throws that away just to pour everything into this trial.
As expected of Mejiro McQueen. It seemed she saw right through everything from Satono Diamond's running.
Haah, haah, haah, haah...

Are you asking me to... hold back?
Just to protect my body... But, that's...

We must walk this path. And—we will definitely achieve my dream
and our family's greatest wish. That is the very reason we met, after all.
Which is to say, "winning a GⅠ in the future." Conditioning her for 2400m when her body isn't fully developed yet carries far too great a risk.
(Wait, she's spurting already here...?! She passed me...?!)
—Though she overtook her for a split second, she was pulled away from relentlessly right after, resulting in Satono Diamond's defeat.
Yaaaahhhhhh!!

Quite impressive speed. —However!
HAAAAAHHHHH!!
This is precisely what we wanted to show you! The proper midpoint toward our dream, as we envisioned it. The utmost we can present to you today!
(I see. So that is what this was all about.)

And—we wish to entrust our beloved daughter to you.
We shall put our trust in the two of you who trust each other.

I see... Now I understand...
I see... Yes... That's why...

Waaahh, Trainer, we did it!
We did it, both of us!
(The final straight is coming up! The real match begins no—what?!)

Well then, let us move to the evaluation. She did end up falling
behind at the finish, but... I would like to hear McQueen-san's thoughts.

What matters most to the two of us... is making our dream come true.
Not today's trial.

(So naive... How terribly naive. Did you truly think you could sustain
such an early move to the very end? This is as far as you go, Satono-san!)

Perhaps we have failed to fully commit ourselves to our dream until now.
By obsessing over tradition and our family name, we failed to win a G1.
Dia... you...
*pant, pant, pant, pant*!

Even if it means sacrificing my one and only youth, there is a path
I must walk... That is why, right here and now—

The only ones who ever grasp their desired dreams—are those prepared to
cast everything else aside and pursue them with single-minded devotion.

Everyone else was frantically chasing the Triple Crown... Yet I chose not to prioritize it,
instead setting my sights on the Tenno Sho (Spring), the race dearest to the Mejiros.

Our dream—is still in the making. Let us take the Satono family's long-cherished wish,
'to win a G1 and shine at the pinnacle,' as our shared dream, and forge ahead.

Huh? Reduce my training volume? What's more, passing the trial
isn't even our priority...? Trainer-san, what do you mean by that?

...I see, it all makes sense now. That premature move before
the final straight was made with the final stretch of a 2,000m race in mind...

Satono Diamond's father exchanged glances with her mother,
and with a slow nod—

Satono-san, what... What is the meaning of this?
Why would you make such a reckless, unwinnable move...?
